summary.label: The idea
summary.title: Progress without perfection.
summary.body: Quitting rarely happens in a perfectly straight line. Calmber turns it into a gradual, understandable journey where a difficult moment never erases the work already done.

features.title: Build a plan around real life
features.body: Choose a pace and routine, then follow daily limits toward a quit day.

features.title: Log honestly and learn
features.body: Record cigarettes, correct past days and understand timing, money and patterns without judgment.

features.title: Get support when a craving hits
features.body: Pause, breathe, delay or ride the urge with a lung buddy that reacts and recovers with you.

cta.title: Take the next breath.

summary.label: The idea
summary.title: Make ordinary steps feel worth chasing.
summary.body: Step goals are easy to ignore when they feel solitary. WalkBop turns the walking you already do into a shared weekly contest where every gap, overtake, item, and comeback gives you a reason to move again.

features.title: Race with real steps
features.body: Connect Apple Health and turn your weekly step total into a live score, position, and distance from the friends around you.

features.title: Change the race with items
features.body: Earn mystery crates by walking, then use playful items to attack, defend, or boost at the moment that matters.

features.title: Build a rivalry that resets every week
features.body: Invite friends, follow the chase, see your racer react, and begin a fresh story when the next weekly race starts.

cta.body: Take a closer look on the App Store.

footer.note: Apple Health access is optional but required to use real walking steps in a live race. WalkBop shares weekly race totals with participating friends, not individual Health samples.

hero.description: A calm, private migraine journal for capturing episodes, understanding recorded patterns, and preparing clearer conversations with healthcare professionals.

screenshots.alt: MigraLoom Log screen with sample episodes
MigraLoom Patterns screen with sample records
MigraLoom Reports screen with sample records

summary.label: The idea
summary.title: Remember less. Bring a clearer record.
summary.body: Migraine days make detailed note-taking difficult, and important context is easy to forget later. MigraLoom makes the first entry fast, then lets users add detail when they are ready and turn the record into something useful.

features.title: Record an episode quickly
features.body: Start with timing and intensity, then add symptoms, pain location, medication, and notes when it feels manageable.

features.title: See only recorded patterns
features.body: Summarize frequency, duration, intensity, and recurring context without presenting guesses as medical conclusions.

features.title: Prepare for appointments
features.body: Create a structured visit summary and export a PDF only when the user chooses to share it.

cta.title: Try MigraLoom for yourself.
cta.body: Take a closer look on the App Store.

footer.note: No account required. The first five episodes are free; one payment unlocks further recording. Journal data is stored on your iPhone and may be included in Apple device backups. Optional diagnostics are off by default. Screenshots use sample records.
